name: obsidian-crate
description: Sync vault files and reminders with Cloudflare R2.
author: Kaan Biryol

scripts.build:site: npm run build:site:images && npm run build:site:crate-ui && npm run build:site:docs
scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run typecheck && npm run build:plugin
scripts.release:check: npm run security:check && npm run build:worker && export CRATE_WORKER_PREBUILT=1 && npm run check && npm run check:server-revision && npm run test:server-package && npm run test:pwa-preview && npm run build:plugin && npm run test:reading && npm run check:css-scope && npm run size-check && npm run verify:release-artifacts && npm run typecheck:visual && npm run test:visual && npm run test:activity-browser && npm run test:file-history-browser && npm run test:plugin-dialogs && npm run test:pwa-browser && npm run release:candidate
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test:ci: node --test scripts/source-references.test.mjs scripts/release-verification.test.mjs scripts/prepare-release.test.mjs scripts/shortcut-release.test.mjs scripts/development-shortcut.test.mjs scripts/browser-tests.test.mjs scripts/pwa-asset-version.test.mjs tests/browser/support/preview/pwa-preview-assets.test.mjs scripts/visual-preview.test.mjs scripts/visual-test-run.test.mjs scripts/clean.test.mjs scripts/site-deployment.test.mjs scripts/build-changelog.test.mjs scripts/tab-indentation.test.mjs scripts/check-style-tokens.test.mjs
scripts.test:worker-runtime: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts
scripts.benchmark:reminders: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/reminders/capacity.integration.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run test:worker-runtime && npm run test:local-server
scripts.check:source: npm run build:worker && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:worker && npm run typecheck:service-worker && npm run deadcode && npm run notices:check && npm run check:contracts && npm run check:style-tokens && npm run test:ci && npm run test:server-revision && npm run test:recovery && npm test
scripts.security:check: npm run security:audit && npm run security:secrets
scripts.benchmark:sync: npm run build:worker && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/sync/capacity.integration.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:page-titles: npm run build && vitest run src/cloudflare/worker/link-title.test.ts src/sync/worker-api/page-title.test.ts src/pwa/page-title-api.test.ts && vitest run --config vitest.cloudflare.config.ts src/cloudflare/worker/link-title.integration.ts && node scripts/visual-test-run.mjs tests/visual/page-titles.spec.ts tests/visual/lexical-trial.spec.ts --workers=2
scripts.test:lexical: vitest run src/reminders/ui/shared/lexical/reminderDocument.test.ts && node scripts/visual-test-run.mjs tests/visual/lexical-trial.spec.ts tests/visual/page-titles.spec.ts --workers=2 && playwright test --config tests/editor-contract/playwright.config.ts && node tests/browser/pwa/pwa-editor-contract-test.mjs && node tests/browser/pwa/pwa-editor-selection-test.mjs && node tests/browser/pwa/pwa-ui-performance-test.mjs && node tests/browser/pwa/pwa-focus-test.mjs && node tests/browser/pwa/pwa-draft-recovery-test.mjs && node tests/browser/pwa/pwa-update-test.mjs
scripts.test:reading: npm run build:worker && npm run test:reading-server && npm run test:reading-browser
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:worker:dev && npm run typecheck && npm run build:plugin:dev
scripts.test:reading-server: npm run test:reading-extraction && node --test scripts/reading-server.test.mjs scripts/reading-shortcut-server.test.mjs scripts/reading-shortcut.test.mjs
scripts.test:reading-browser: npm run test:reading-browser:library && npm run test:reading-browser:annotations
